The '''2015–16 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team''' represented [[Wichita State University]] in the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They played their home games [[Charles Koch Arena]] and were led by ninth-year head coach [[Gregg Marshall]]. They were members of the [[Missouri Valley Conference]]. They finished the season 26–9, 16–2 in Missouri Valley play to win the MVC regular season championship. They lost in the semifinals of the [[2016 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|MVC tournament]] to [[2015–16 Northern Iowa Panthers men's basketball team|Northern Iowa]]. The Shockers received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Tournament|NCAA tournament]] as an 11 seed. They defeated [[2015–16 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] in the First Four and [[2015–16 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]] in the first round before losing to [[2015–16 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami (FL)]] in the second round.

==Previous season==
The [[2014–15 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Shockers]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]] 30–5, 17–1 in MVC play to win the regular season Missouri Valley championship. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2015 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|Missouri Valley tournament]] where they lost to [[2014–15 Illinois State Redbirds men's basketball team|Illinois State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2014–15 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]] in the second round and [[2014–15 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in the Third Round before losing in the Sweet Sixteen to [[2014–15 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]].
